engine presents frames, survives a kill and restarts
tests.notes: The VmodV shell is a single process with no separate supervised engine child: the process test renders, SIGKILLs the shell, relaunches over the same userData and asserts the saved snapshot (Group + frames) is restored. It covers the same kill-survival intent; the Electron supervisor restart budget is not recreated.

tests.name: default group is focused by default
tests.notes: VmodV selects the first live Group on startup; there is no Gallery Group to skip.

tests.name: full-screen-quad GL contexts do not request antialiasing
tests.notes: Asserts Chromium WebGL context attributes (antialias:false) on the worker's OffscreenCanvas aux outputs. Native ISF/shader passes are wgpu pipelines with no multisample state, so there is no context attribute to inspect.

tests.name: the Gallery group inherits only while an item is hovered
tests.notes: The legacy worker Gallery Group canvas (inherit=true while hovered) does not exist natively; hover previews are isolated offscreen renders. The compositing intent is asserted by crates/modv-app/src/compositor.rs:module_preview_composites_over_the_live_output.

tests.name: the idle Gallery group canvas is not repainted every frame
tests.notes: Idle Gallery Group repaint avoidance is a worker-canvas optimisation; the VmodV shell has no Gallery Group canvas to repaint. Preview caches are bounded/reset in the scene_preview tests.

tests.notes: Asserts Chromium's main/renderer/GPU/utility child tree is gone after app.quit(). The VmodV shell is one process with no such child tree; tools/vmodv-smoke.sh already asserts windowed runs exit cleanly. An orphan-tree test here would only test Electron's process model.

tests.name: remembers window screens and resolutions between restarts
tests.notes: The process test writes a placement, restarts the VmodV shell and compares the restored bounds; serialisation and clamping stay covered by the window_state unit tests.

tests.name: the Linux bundle omits macOS-only and build-only payloads
tests.notes: Asserts electron-builder bundle contents: app.asar.unpacked, hapticjs/grandiose native addons and Chromium locale .pak files. The VmodV AppImage/.deb has separate packaging checks (tools/vmodv-deb-check.sh, tools/vmodv-smoke.sh) and contains none of these Electron payloads.
